headline: Crypto-asset company SCEX completes capital increase to 10,000 billion VND
summary: SCEX became the second company, after VPBank's CAEX, to meet the VND 10,000 billion minimum capital requirement to provide crypto-asset trading market organisation services. The requirement follows current regulations.
why: Vietnam requires licensed crypto-asset trading platforms to meet minimum capital levels, which shapes which firms can enter the market.
